bullets: Added Solar Pro 4 to the limited-access model list, making it unmetered at full access and gating it on a Solar Pro 4 entitlement flag.
Changed the Freebuff subscription intro discount to a tier-proportional $3, $6, or $15 discount, landing introductory prices at $5, $19, and $45 for Starter, Plus, and Pro tiers.
Added a terminal-state record and awaits-verdict helper to the proposal view so a card keeps watching a sponsored run in flight instead of stopping at the offered state.
Added linked-worktree git grants to sponsored local runs, allowing commits, branch refs, and packed-refs.lock while refusing writes to hooks, config, info, and packed-refs.
Removed the cost disclosure line from the sponsored proposal block, replacing it with a simpler message that the task runs in its own worktree.
Changed multi-device session handoff so a superseded client now receives the count of active sessions on other devices instead of being quietly forced to close.
Reinstated waivers for Desktop conformance rows E-3 through E-7, requiring real backend execution and user action to clear them instead of test simulations.
Removed a behind-the-scenes account deletion proof utility that generated HMAC-SHA256 proofs before permanently wiping Convex accounts.
Added Gemini 3.8 Flash to the free model picker with OpenRouter default routing, premium metered access, and a $0.50 per-session ceiling.
Made Solar Pro 4 available as a limited-access model that is unmetered at full access, joining DeepSeek V4 Flash, GLM 5.3 Flash, and MiMo 2.5.
Added Solar Pro 4 to the limited-access model list, gating it on a Solar Pro 4 entitlement and setting its premium flag to false so it is unmetered.
Stopped showing the freebucks spent dollar amount in the spend ceiling response, removing the secondary daily cap that appeared beside the freebucks meter and caused confusion.
Updated the privacy notice in the app and READMEs to the September 2 Privacy Policy, now explicitly listing agent traces and restricted-partner Cloud repository evaluation.
